evidence.claim: Bank model risk score: 0.79. This is a signal for review, not a verdict.
Transaction amount $292.36 is 6.2x the customer's average ($47.46) but equals the customer's all-time historical maximum — no spend ceiling was broken.
All 44 of this customer's transactions are online Product C — channel, product type, and email domain are fully consistent with normal behavior.
Zero match flag mismatches on the flagged transaction (M1-M9 all clean) — no identity or terminal anomalies detected.
No identity fields present (id_01 through id_33 all absent) — no device or browser anomalies to flag.
Customer resumed normal low-value transactions ($26-$30, risk scores 0.02-0.15) within 3 weeks of the flagged transaction — no disruption in spending pattern consistent with fraud.
Customer/card has 1 prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4160) — elevated residual risk, but that incident was separate and current transaction shows no matching indicators.

case.summary: The $292.36 online purchase matches this customer's established channel (100% online Product C) and equals their historical spending maximum — no ceiling was broken. Zero match flag mismatches, no identity anomalies, and the customer resumed normal low-risk transactions within weeks. The risk score of 0.79 was triggered solely by the amount spike, which is a documented false-positive pattern for single high-value purchases within a customer's historical range. With no corroborating fraud indicators, this is a legitimate transaction. No action required beyond closing the case.
